title: Dual full-auto contention observer (do not collapse)
problem: Default agent instinct kills one of two concurrent full-auto loops; operator framed dual loops as adversarial contention test.

solution.summary: Add observer that detects ≥2 full-auto start processes, records contention metrics, NEVER kills unless --resolve-kill explicitly set by policy ticket.
steps: Enumerate PIDs matching 'full-auto start'; if count≥2 write contention sample: pids, cmdline, state.json mtime, runs.jsonl last lines, daemon.pid freshness.
Patch daemon status and full-auto status to print CONTENTION: N loops when N≥2 without recommending kill.
Add lesson pointer in autonomous agent prompts / staff review signals: adversarial dual-loop = observe only.
verify: With dual loops running: tnf full-auto contend status --json | jq -e '.loopCount >= 2'
Observer process does not change PIDs (before/after pgrep identical)
solution.rollback: Remove contend command; no process impact.

acceptance_probe: Observer reports loopCount≥2 while both PIDs remain alive.
conflicts: Must not conflict with pause/fleet-pause which is explicit policy — only auto-kill is forbidden.
